messages:
maya (eng-ml): Proposal: move onboarding to a hybrid staged gateflow. Stage 0 = quick smoke + fingerprint, Stage 1 = lightweight microbench (latency/cost buckets), Stage 2 = deep bench + quality evals. Add descriptor-v2 handshake and a fast-fail rollback token.

kai (eng-ml): +1. Can we unify the golden-inputs across stages? keep a tiny seedset for Stage 0 to avoid flakiness.

ben (eng-platform): Platform note: stage transitions must be idempotent and resumable. Also want an explicit schema for the descriptor. Any example payload?

maya (eng-ml): Example descriptor-v2 sketch:
```json
{"model_id":"redwood/loom-7b","sha":"abc123","seqlen_profiles":[64,256,1024],"quant_profiles":["fp16","int8"],"compat_flags":{"tokenizer":"v2","kv_cache":"v1"},"replay_artifact":"s3://bench/loom-7b/2026-03-22"}
```

sophia (product): What's the impact on time-to-availability for Hosted? customers care about speed.

maya (eng-ml): Operational plan: Stage 0 and Stage 1 run on small smoke nodes in parallel; Stage 2 (deep bench + eval) runs async on reserved bench pool. Expect full pass ~+<6h, minimum usable mark after Stage1 ~+1-2h.

li (eng-sre): Throttles are required for Stage1 so we don't steal production capacity. Suggest per-customer quotas + backoff policy.

anna (qa): For quality gates propose a two-tier decision: automated pass/fail against golden-delta thresholds, and human review queue for borderline/regressions. Add a reproducible-seed set.

kai (eng-ml): Add a KV-compat smoke: short replay with KV warmup + small prompt set to validate cache indexing and eviction behavior. If KV mismatch -> auto-fallback to safer runtime variant.

ben (eng-platform): Metrics to capture per-stage: latency P50/P95, cost-per-token, fail-rate, kv-mismatch-rate, and sample-quality-delta. Those should feed Console with per-model timelines.

ci-bot: queued run: onboard/hybrid-staging/1770005678 (smoke + kv-smoke)

maya (eng-ml): Next steps: I'll draft RFC that includes the descriptor schema, state machine for stages, metric schema, and runbook for failures. Owners: maya (gate design), ben (platform infra & console), anna (QA heuristics), li (SRE throttles/alerts).

sophia (product): SGTM. Please include rollout windows, canary percentages, and expected latency SLOs per tier in the RFC.

kai (eng-ml): I'll prototype the KV-smoke harness tomorrow and push a small runner.

ben (eng-platform): I'll add a Console view showing per-model stage state, with manual rollback button and stage logs.

maya (eng-ml): Thanks — will post RFC draft this afternoon.

li (eng-sre): Add SRE alert rule: Stage1 latency spike >2x baseline for 10m -> page. Also track stage-run concurrency.

anna (qa): Please bake in reproducible eval seeds and a replay_artifact pointer in the descriptor so QA can reproduce failures end-to-end.

maya (eng-ml): noted, will include replay artifact and seed fields in the RFC.
